title: Recover manifest — Track B -> Track A (`win_recovery_engine recover --manifest <file>`)
description: Items are candidate objects copied from candidates.json (extra keys are ignored) plus output naming fields chosen by the analysis layer.

destination.description: Absolute directory on a volume that is NOT being recovered from

output_name.description: File name to write; sanitised by the engine; collisions get ' (n)' suffixes

relative_dir.description: Sub-directory below destination ('/' or '\\' separated, '..' is stripped)
